premise: A misplaced royal dispatch makes you commander of a gate that both armies have reasons to fear.

act1_gate.title: I · The Wrong Commander
act1_gate.subtitle: A seal is not the same thing as an order worth following.

dialogue.speaker: Commander
dialogue.text: The dispatch names someone taller. And considerably more dead.

dialogue.speaker: {ally}
dialogue.text: Then perhaps we have been given the better commander.

dialogue.speaker: Gatekeeper
dialogue.text: Two roads from the orchard. One gate. The first watch is yours.

dialogue.speaker: Commander
dialogue.text: We have two allies, a few old towers, and enough time to choose where to stand.

choices.label: Show them the mistaken orders
choices.detail: Honesty earns the watch's trust: +20 starting crowns.

choices.label: Ask them to stand with you anyway
choices.detail: A shared vow strengthens the gate: +10 gate health.

act2_ford.title: II · Friends and Monsters
act2_ford.subtitle: Not every raised hand holds a weapon.

dialogue.speaker: Scout
dialogue.text: There are hundreds of them. Seedfolk, lantern spirits, whole families on the riverbank.

dialogue.speaker: {ally}
dialogue.text: Those at the back are carrying the wounded. They are not an attack line.

dialogue.speaker: Commander
dialogue.text: Then we defend the ford without turning frightened people into enemies.

dialogue.speaker: Veyra
dialogue.text: Keep a place where our surrender can be seen. If you can hold it, we can talk.

choices.label: Keep the sanctuary open
choices.detail: Remember their surrender. Mercy will shape your ending.

choices.label: Defend the crossings first
choices.detail: Hold a tighter line: +15 crowns for prepared defenses.

act3_rescue.title: III · The Price of Victory
act3_rescue.subtitle: There is always more than one thing a victory can cost.

dialogue.speaker: Commander
dialogue.text: The aqueduct is breaking. We cannot reach both enclosures before the next charge.

dialogue.speaker: {ally}
dialogue.text: One holds our missing watch. The other holds the families who followed the surrender flags.

dialogue.speaker: Orun
dialogue.text: Choose whom your road reaches first. We will carry the choice with you.

dialogue.speaker: Commander
dialogue.text: No one becomes a number in my report. Tell me their names.

choices.label: Search for our missing ally
choices.detail: Recover one recently downed ally, if any; otherwise receive a 25-crown supply cache.

choices.label: Open the families' enclosure
choices.detail: Protect the refugees. Their repair crews bring +35 crowns.

act4_return.title: IV · The Choosing
act4_return.subtitle: The road home has more than one locked door.

dialogue.speaker: Commander
dialogue.text: The capital still has swords for hire. The prison still has people it has forgotten.

dialogue.speaker: {ally}
dialogue.text: A contract can buy time. An opened cell can earn trust. Neither tells us a person's worth.

dialogue.speaker: Commander
dialogue.text: We ask for volunteers. No one is conscripted for being poor, noble, or in chains.

dialogue.speaker: Quartermaster
dialogue.text: The survivors need reinforcements. Choose carefully; their lives will be part of your ending.

choices.label: Visit the capital contracts
choices.detail: Begin among the mercenaries; the prison candidates remain available too.

choices.label: Open the prison's recruitment room
choices.detail: Begin among the prisoners; the capital candidates remain available too.

act4_road.title: IV · A Road for Everyone
act4_road.subtitle: Reinforcements are only useful if they reach the last stand.

dialogue.speaker: Quartermaster
dialogue.text: The king's siege scouts are closing the crossroads. We can hold the escort road or cut through the old gardens.

dialogue.speaker: {ally}
dialogue.text: If we stay, the refugees come with us. If we leave, we reach the palace before the scouts.

dialogue.speaker: Commander
dialogue.text: Speed saves lives too. But it never saves the same lives.

dialogue.speaker: Quartermaster
dialogue.text: The road watch has marked places for four towers. Your orders?

choices.label: Hold the escort road
choices.detail: Play the recovery defense: victory earns an escort seal and +75 crowns for Crownroot Court.

choices.label: Take the garden shortcut
choices.detail: Skip this optional battle and reach Crownroot Court immediately.

act5_court.title: V · The Last Stand
act5_court.subtitle: A kingdom is the people who are left to rebuild it.

dialogue.speaker: Avarren
dialogue.text: They called my people monsters, then burned every road we used to leave.

dialogue.speaker: Commander
dialogue.text: And you answered by sending an army through homes that never gave that order.

dialogue.speaker: {ally}
dialogue.text: Both can be true. Neither makes the next death necessary.

dialogue.speaker: Avarren
dialogue.text: Then bring your little company through my court. Let us see what your mercy can defend.

choices.label: Break the siege machinery
choices.detail: Salvaged fittings provide +40 crowns for the final approach.

choices.label: Prepare shelter for the wounded
choices.detail: A stronger evacuation line adds +15 gate health.

act5_throne.title: V · The Uncrowned Threshold
act5_throne.subtitle: The crown is cracked. The person beneath it is still listening.

dialogue.speaker: Avarren
dialogue.text: I remember every name. That is why I cannot put the crown down.

dialogue.speaker: Commander
dialogue.text: Remembering the lost is not permission to keep making more of them.

dialogue.speaker: {ally}
dialogue.text: The root anchors feed his shield. Leave a clear road between the warning marks.

dialogue.speaker: Commander
dialogue.text: Together, then. With everyone who is still here.

choices.label: Speak the names of the lost
choices.detail: The king hesitates: his final guard begins with 8% less health.

choices.label: Challenge the crown, not his people
choices.detail: Take +25 crowns into the last defense.

judgment.title: A Crown Set Down
judgment.subtitle: Victory gives you a choice. It does not make that choice for you.

dialogue.speaker: Avarren
dialogue.text: There is nothing left behind this crown except what I have done.

dialogue.speaker: Commander
dialogue.text: Then let the people who survived decide what comes after it.

dialogue.speaker: {ally}
dialogue.text: Mercy can ask for repair. Justice can refuse revenge.

dialogue.speaker: Avarren
dialogue.text: Will you let me help rebuild what I broke?

choices.label: Forgive him — require reparations
choices.detail: Disarm the king and rebuild with accountability.

choices.label: Refuse pardon — bring him to judgment
choices.detail: Seal the crown and escort him to a public hearing.

defeat_finale.title: The Road From Ruin
defeat_finale.subtitle: A defeat does not decide whether anyone was worth saving.

dialogue.speaker: Commander
dialogue.text: The threshold has fallen. The last evacuation road is still open.

dialogue.speaker: {ally}
dialogue.text: We can rally with the remaining watchtowers, or take our survivors beyond the roots.

dialogue.speaker: Commander
dialogue.text: No speeches about glorious losses. Give me a count of the living.

dialogue.speaker: Quartermaster
dialogue.text: The watch can spare extra fittings for one more attempt. The decision is yours.

choices.label: Rally for another attempt
choices.detail: Keep surviving allies and gain 150 extra crowns for the defense.

choices.label: Lead the survivors to safety
choices.detail: Finish this run with a defeat epilogue and an earned title.

ending_copy.forgive: The crown rests in open hands. Avarren lays down his power and joins the work of repair. Neither side forgets the dead; both agree to stop adding to their number.
ending_copy.refuse_pardon: The crown is sealed in a copper chest. Avarren walks to a public hearing under the guard of people from both armies. There will be testimony before there is a sentence.
ending_copy.defeat: You lead the living out by the last unbroken road. The court is lost, but the story carries the names of the people you chose to save. Another commander may yet return.
